responsibility: This file implements the fallback behavior for GCC's common target hook layer. It supplies the default runtime routines referenced by the gcc_targetm_common hook vector for choosing the target's exception-unwind model (generic, forced DWARF2, or forced setjmp/longjmp based on configure-time support), accepting target-specific command-line options when no special handling is needed, enumerating valid option values when none are provided, and exporting an empty optimization-default table sentinel. In practice it is the shared implementation counterpart to common-target.def/common-targhooks.h, providing concrete default hook functions and data used by targets that do not override these common option and unwind-policy services.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/common/common-targhooks.h, this source file provides the actual fallback definitions and storage for the common target-hook helpers—implementing the unwind-selection routines, default option handlers, and the empty_optimization_table object that the header only declares.
